title: Agent
description: Defines who does the work. Persona, model, tools, permissions, budget.

name.description: Agent identifier. Referenced by tasks. REQUIRED in Workflow context. Optional in AgentProfile (name comes from metadata).

model.description: Explicit model identifier (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4', 'gpt-4o'). Supports ${ENV_VAR} interpolation. Use this OR model_tier, not both.

model_tier.description: Portable model tier. Runtime maps to a concrete model via runtime.model_tiers. frontier = best available, use sparingly for planning/architecture. standard = balanced cost/quality for general tasks. fast = cheap and fast for well-defined mechanical work. embedding = embedding/search model. Use model: for explicit model identifiers.

persona.description: Structured agent identity. Who the agent is, how it behaves, what it knows. Replaces unstructured system prompts.

instructions.description: Raw system prompt in markdown. Bridges from AGENTS.md / .cursorrules. Use for migration; prefer persona + principles for new definitions.

tools.description: Tool names available to this agent.

principles.description: Behavioral principles. Injected into agent system prompt.

permissions.description: Security sandbox. Filesystem, network, shell, and secret access controls.

budget.description: Token and cost limits for this agent across the workflow.

model_fallback.description: Fallback model chain. If primary model is unavailable or budget exceeded, try these in order.

max_concurrent_tasks.description: Max tasks this agent can work simultaneously. Default 1 (serial). Increase for agents that can safely parallelize (e.g., independent file edits).

output_format.description:
Controls whether the agent must produce a structured TaskResult block.

'stream' (default): agent outputs free-form text; runtime may apply heuristic extraction of typed outputs from fenced ```json blocks.

'structured': runtime MUST append a closing instruction to the task prompt requiring the agent to emit a final fenced ```oap-result``` block containing a valid TaskResult JSON object. Runtime MUST parse this block and use it as the authoritative source for outputs, artifacts, and coordination signals (build_ready). Takes precedence over any heuristic extraction. Use this when epoch coordination or downstream output interpolation is required.

TaskResult.description: Structured result block emitted by agents when output_format=structured. The runtime injects the instruction to produce this as the final fenced ```oap-result``` block. Runtimes MUST parse it and promote its fields to OAP envelopes (signal.output, signal.artifact, build.ready).

status.description: Task completion status. 'ok' = success, all success_criteria met. 'error' = terminal failure. 'partial' = work done but some criteria unmet.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was done. Runtime MAY surface this as the task's final log entry.

outputs.description: Named output values. Keys SHOULD match the task's declared outputs[]. Scalars (string, number, boolean) are promoted to signal.output envelopes. Nested objects and arrays are stored as-is and accessible via ${tasks.<name>.outputs.<key>}.

artifacts.description: File paths written or modified by this task. Promoted to signal.artifact envelopes. Used by the file registry for epoch attribution and conflict detection. Paths are relative to the workflow's working_dir.

build_ready.description: Set to true when the agent has finished all file writes and is ready for a build epoch. Equivalent to sending build.ready — the runtime calls epoch.MarkReady() on behalf of the agent. Only meaningful when a build_policy is defined on the workflow. Eliminates the need for auto_ack.

error.description: Error message when status=error or status=partial. Required if status != ok.

tokens_used.description: Self-reported token usage. Runtime MAY prefer its own tracked values if available.

max_tokens.description: Maximum total tokens (input + output) this agent can consume.

max_cost_usd.description: Maximum USD cost. Runtime tracks based on model pricing.

on_exceed.description: stop = halt agent. fallback = switch to model_fallback chain. warn = log warning, continue.
